record.original_question: For the open-shop throughput problem O|p_ij=1, r_j|sum w_j U_j with unit-time operations and release dates, is the problem fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by the number of machines?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 15. Is O|pi j=1,rj|ΣwjUj fixed-parameter tractable parameterized by the number of machines?
Open shop scheduling, denoted by “O” in the α-field: the processing order of the operations of each job is unrestricted and must be decided by an algorithm.
Release dates. Each job j may have a release date rj, before which it cannot be started. In this case, we add “rj” to the β-field.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the following open-shop scheduling problem. There are $m$ machines $M_1,\dots,M_m$ and $n$ jobs $J_1,\dots,J_n$. Each job $J_j$ consists of $m$ operations $O_{1j},\dots,O_{mj}$, where operation $O_{ij}$ must be processed on machine $M_i$ and has unit processing time $p_{ij}=1$. The operations of a single job may be processed on their respective machines in any order, but no two operations of the same job can be processed simultaneously, and each machine processes at most one operation at a time. Each job $J_j$ has a release date $r_j\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$ (no operation of $J_j$ may start before time $r_j$), a due date $d_j\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}$, and a nonnegative integer weight $w_j$. A schedule assigns to every operation $O_{ij}$ an integer start time $s_{ij}\ge r_j$ subject to the machine and job constraints; job $J_j$ is on time if all its operations finish by time $d_j$, in which case $U_j=0$, otherwise $U_j=1$. The objective is to minimize $\sum_{j=1}^n w_j U_j$, the weighted number of tardy jobs.

Question: Is this problem (denoted in standard scheduling notation $O\mid p_{ij}=1, r_j\mid \sum w_j U_j$) fixed-parameter tractable when parameterized by the number of machines $m$? Equivalently, does there exist an algorithm solving every instance in time $f(m)\cdot (n+\max_j(r_j+d_j+w_j))^{O(1)}$ for some computable function $f$?
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface a paper resolving this specific question (FPT status of the unit-time open-shop problem with release dates minimizing the weighted number of tardy jobs, parameterized by the number of machines). Related results exist (e.g., polynomial-time algorithms for fixed numbers of machines without release dates, and FPT results for parallel-machine variants), but none clearly settle this case in either direction.
